field_descriptions.composer: The person or organization who wrote a composition, or who is the composer of a work performed at some event.
field_descriptions.first_performance: The date and place the work was first performed.
field_descriptions.identifier: The identifier property represents any kind of identifier for any kind of [[Thing]], such as ISBNs, GTIN codes, UUIDs etc. Schema.org provides dedicated properties for representing many of these, either as textual strings or as URL (URI) links. See [background notes](/docs/datamodel.html#identifierBg) for more details.
field_descriptions.included_composition: Smaller compositions included in this work (e.g. a movement in a symphony).
field_descriptions.iswc_code: The International Standard Musical Work Code for the composition.
field_descriptions.lyricist: The person who wrote the words.
field_descriptions.music_arrangement: An arrangement derived from the composition.
field_descriptions.music_composition_form: The type of composition (e.g. overture, sonata, symphony, etc.).
field_descriptions.musical_key: The key, mode, or scale this composition uses.
field_descriptions.recorded_as: An audio recording of the work.
